connector.name: Whoop MCP by davidmosiah
connector.registryDescription: Privacy-first, unofficial WHOOP MCP server for AI health, sleep, recovery, and performance agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package whoop-mcp-unofficial. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_ID
env.description: WHOOP OAuth client ID. Optional when configured with whoop-mcp-server setup.

env.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: WHOOP OAuth client secret. Prefer whoop-mcp-server setup so this secret is stored in ~/.whoop-mcp/config.json instead of MCP client config.

env.name: WHOOP_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: Redirect URI configured in the WHOOP Developer Dashboard. Optional when configured with whoop-mcp-server setup.

env.name: WHOOP_TOKEN_PATH
env.description: Optional local path for OAuth tokens. Defaults to ~/.whoop-mcp/tokens.json.

env.name: WHOOP_PRIVACY_MODE
env.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured. raw means full WHOOP API payloads, not raw device sensor streams.

env.name: WHOOP_CACHE
env.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

env.name: WHOOP_CACHE_PATH
env.description: Optional local SQLite cache path. Defaults to ~/.whoop-mcp/cache.sqlite.

env.name: WHOOP_NO_CACHE
env.description: Set to true to bypass the in-memory HTTP response cache (60s TTL for GET only). POST/PUT/DELETE and 4xx/5xx responses are never cached regardless.
